settings.title: Office settings
settings.intro: Deadlines are not hardcoded. Each office sets the days here.
settings.sendTranslated: Email and WhatsApp go out in the client’s language. The original stays in the file.
settings.poderDays: Power of attorney — days before expiry
settings.nudgeDays: Ask again — days since the last request
settings.staleDays: Stale file — days without movement (0 = off)
settings.loadError: Office settings could not be loaded.
settings.blockOrderHint: The arrows change order. This is not a free page builder.
settings.staffLocaleHint: This is only for you. The client language lives on their card.
settings.cronHint: Draft reminders are prepared every morning at 07:00 Madrid. You send them, not the cron.
settings.teamHint: The owner invites a gestor or asistente. Three people at most. An asistente cannot hide a file.
settings.alreadyMember: This email is already in the office.
settings.teamFull: This office already has three people.

auth.intro: Office sign-in. Support accounts enter only via impersonation.
auth.forbidden: Support accounts belong here only after impersonation from the Support app.
auth.forbiddenHint: This is the office app. A Support account belongs in the Support app ({supportUrl}), then impersonation into the office.
auth.paymentRequired: This office licence is not active.
auth.resetSent: If the account exists, an email with a link will arrive. Check spam too.
auth.resetError: The reset link could not be sent.
auth.resetIntro: Enter a new password for your account.
auth.resetNeedLink: Open the link from the email. Here you only set the new password, or request the link again.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.updatePasswordError: The password could not be saved.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: This email is not confirmed yet.

impersonation.missingToken: The URL hash is missing refresh_token. The other origin has no session without it.
impersonation.sessionClosed: The support session is closed or expired.

inbox.title: Today
inbox.empty: No deadlines or gaps. Open a folder or create a client.
inbox.askedRecently: You already asked. The next draft waits for the office interval.
inbox.noChannel: This client has no email or phone.
inbox.snoozeHint: The row leaves today. The deadline itself stays. Nothing is deleted.
inbox.manualSaved: The deadline is in the inbox.

clients.title: Clients
clients.name: Name
clients.cardLoadError: Could not load the client card.
clients.softDeleteConfirm: The folder leaves the list. History stays. The owner can restore it.
clients.onlyOwnerRestore: Only the office owner can restore it.
clients.documentsEmpty: No DNI, NIE or passport yet.

audit.title: Audit
audit.hint: Who opened the card, the folder or a file. Uploads show which document. Entries are never deleted.
audit.loadError: Could not load the audit log.

messages.title: Message
messages.intro: You write in Spanish. The original stays in the file. Translation to the client language comes with the translator; for now the same text goes out.
messages.subject: Subject
messages.historyEmpty: No draft or sent request yet.
messages.discardConfirm: The draft is hidden. The audit trail stays.

folder.title: Folder
folder.subtitle: The same two sheets. The pencil is the switch.
folder.offBlocksHint: Switched-off blocks sit at the bottom so the folder starts with what the office actually does.
folder.nameMismatch: The name on the document ({doc}) does not match the card ({card}). Check that the file belongs to this client.
folder.requiredDocsAny: A contract or an invoice is enough: {types}
folder.removeConfirm: The document will be hidden from the folder. The file stays in storage.
folder.fileTooBig: The file is larger than 32 MB.
folder.fileType: Attach a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC).
folder.extractError: The file is in the folder. The transcript could not be read — open it and save the fields yourself.
folder.transcriptEmpty: The transcript is not saved yet. You save the proposal.
folder.purged: The original file was purged. The transcript remains.
folder.purgeConfirm: The file in Storage will be deleted. The transcript and audit stay. The original cannot be restored.
folder.purgeWarnLegal: This is an official paper (escritura / tax). The original will no longer open.
folder.offReason: Why are you turning this block off?

expedientes.title: Files
expedientes.intro: Checklist and a deadline. No tax calculation.
expedientes.softDeleteConfirm: The file leaves the list. History stays.
expedientes.asistenteNoDelete: An asistente cannot hide a file.

provision.hint: Three numbers from movements. No VAT, no VeriFactu.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.intro: It searches clients and proposes fields from text or a photo. You save. Nothing writes or sends by itself.
ai.input: NIE, name, or text to propose from
ai.extractEmpty: Nothing could be read from the document. No proposal was saved.
ai.noHoles: This folder has no gap to ask about.
ai.prefill: Open the folder with the proposal
ai.factsEmpty: This client has no saved document fields yet. Attach a file and save the proposal first.
ai.officeEmpty: Nothing matching is filled on the desks. Chat reads saved fields, not PDF bytes.
ai.officePartial: I only read what is saved on the desk.
ai.fileOnly: The file is in the folder. Fields will appear as a proposal — you save.
ai.emptyThread: Ask about a client, NIE, or a document. You save — nothing is written or sent on its own.
ai.savedHint: This conversation is saved in your office.
ai.writeError: The conversation could not be saved.
